name: StepFenv
description: Tempo-synced step filter envelope for NTS-3. Each step fires a cutoff envelope (attack 0, decay set, sustain 0, release 0) into a resonant low-pass on AUDIO IN. X = cutoff, Y = env depth. Touch resets the grid.

params.name: ENV
params.detail: How far each step opens the cutoff above CUT

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Filter envelope decay (~15 ms to 1.2 s). Attack, sustain, and release stay at 0
